title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; parity fixes and v-bump
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Python/TS/Go SDKs: unify auth header handling and retry backoff
Streaming API: stabilized event boundaries and better cancellation semantics
Version bump to v1.101.0 across SDKs; parity fixes for TS/Go to match Python ergonomics
description:
Context: We maintain 3 SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) and over time auth, retry, and streaming ergonomics have diverged. This PR unifies the surface area and behavior so that client code has the same experience across languages. Motivation: reduce developer friction, make release behavior deterministic, and unblock platform teams who rely on parity when switching runtimes.

What this PR does: - Centralizes auth header extraction and token refresh logic to consistent helper shapes across SDKs. - Standardizes retry semantics: default retryable status codes, exponential backoff with jitter, and a shared max-retries config. - Stabilizes streaming API semantics: message framing, heartbeat handling, and explicit cancellation to ensure language parity. - Includes small ergonomic changes: named keyword args in Python, consistent options object in TS, and context-aware Go client options. - Bumps SDK versions to v1.101.0 for Python/TS/Go and updates changelogs.

Compatibility notes: No breaking changes for typical usage. There are some subtle renames in advanced retry hooks (documented in release notes) — we preserved backward-compatible aliases for one release cycle.

Testing: Ran full CI matrix (py: 3.9/3.11, ts: node 16/18, go: 1.20/1.21). Added integration tests for streaming cancellation and a cross-language conformance test that validates identical header behavior under token refresh. Manual QA: smoke-tested hosted API end-to-end with Dedicated fallback.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement auth helper parity across SDKs
- [x] Implement unified retry/backoff module and config
- [x] Update streaming event framing & cancellation semantics
- [x] Add unit & integration tests
- [x] Update changelogs and version numbers
- [x] Confirm CI green across matrix

Notes for reviewers: Focus on the retry policy defaults and streaming cancellation semantics. Language-specific implementations are intentionally idiomatic but should match the documented behavior in the description. Related: ENG-2345 (unify SDK behavior), SUP-1023 (customer reported streaming cancel bug).
